items.item: Grep and reading of the records' non-history fields
items.how: Searched every record's fields outside history, text_versions, ids, references and declarations for warrant, unasserted, not asserted, neither asserted, does not assert, without asserting, two readings, ranks under, is better, good and evil, 善恶, 不被断言, 不断言, plus binds no / not bound, makers, calling widening better, 'one pair of readings', 塑规者 and 规则怎样被读 (about 360 hits before). Read each hit by its sense. Changed 59 records: 223 field edits, 76 of them the Chinese word change. Scripted exact-substring edits, each asserted to occur once in its field. Records re-dumped in their own format (indent 2), so each diff is only the changed lines. All JSON valid.

items.item: The continuation condition as a hypothesis, not 'stated and not asserted' (E6, E8)
items.how: The shared hypothesis line in closure-verdict-meets-continuation-condition, continuation-condition-yields-living-significance, significance-retained-within-margin and whole-and-regions-and-bounded-centers now reads 'It is a hypothesis of the (comparison) theorems and is not proved here' (zh 此处不加证明). 'Which the theory states and does not assert', 'the theory does not assert the condition', 'never asserted', 'it is not asserted', 'without asserting it' and their zh forms (陈述而不断言, 理论不断言这一条件, 从不断言, 并未被断言) are re-said as 'which the theorems take as a hypothesis' or the like. This covers closure-verdict does_not_show[5] (its zh also aligned to the English 'is not an axiom'), practical-judgment hypotheses[0], living-significance-on-held-lives hypotheses[4], metaethical-core hypotheses[0] ('not establishing it'), positive-ground-open-futures overview.evidence, theory-of-becoming-foundation related[7], wisdom-root hypotheses[1] (now 'where it ranks, it states what it ranks under ... C or self-concern for order'), conveyance-crosses-the-boundary hypotheses[3], self-concern-through-dependence hypotheses[0] and what-the-step-across-standpoints-reaches hypotheses[0].

'calling widening better is C, a premise' became 'ranking by widening is C, a named order' (a-narrowing-above-its-widening, widening-as-what-every-positive-weighting-ranks), and 'C's' in keeping-widening-is-generation-losing-nothing. comparison-by-widening: the statement's 'C's normative content moves into calling widening better' became 'what C adds moves into ranking by widening'. laws[9] now matches 07 line 359 ('that courses are ranked by this relation is C's content, read in, not derived from the grammar'). The 'one pair of readings 07 examines' tails (a-pair-tolerates-only-within-a-window, errors-by-chance-in-a-pair-keeping-mutual-withholding, what-decides-giving-against-keeping-on-a-flow) became '07 says how they emerge together from continuation'. when-holding-for-a-reading-stands-above-a-route and when-no-route-stands-above-a-revision: 'that comparison is the ethics', under the condition for scope and C for order' became 'for an order someone holds, such as C with the (continuation) condition for scope', as 07 line 748 says it.

items.item: one-root-to-its-edge: the premises of the ethics (boundary field)
items.how: Scope basis: 'No warrant from outside is sought, and none binding every possible mind is claimed' became 'No should stands beyond becoming, so there is no warrant binding every mind to find, and the ethics, which emerges from continuation, does not wait on one (chapter 7: its §3 for the condition, its §4 for the order it gives with self-concern, its §8 for what is offered)'. Order name 'C, calling widening better' / 'C，谓扩大为更好' became E7's gloss, 'C (widening: keeping all another course keeps and letting more form)' / 'C（扩大：保有另一进程所保有的一切，并让更多形成）', as the glossaries now say. Order basis: 'What ranks is an order a reader holds, C or another ... A reason for C is open apart from the condition' became: the condition alone orders nothing; where it holds de se, self-concern ranks every extension between listed level paths as C does, one way, so there C is not a second premise; beyond that C is a named order. ReadsNoOrder.not_entails's sentence is kept. The keys and Lean names are unchanged; boundary.py's field checks pass (test_boundary green).

Each open item quoting a changed does-not-show line word for word was changed with it, eight in all: becoming-renewal-reading, a-pair-tolerates-only-within-a-window, errors-by-chance-in-a-pair-keeping-mutual-withholding, what-decides-giving-against-keeping-on-a-flow, recurring-reference-revision, a-reading-informed-and-revalued, what-a-gate-keeps (organizational-rule-inheritance's line) and succession-on-a-funded-carrier. No near-match quotes of changed lines were left. A search of dynamics.json's own text for frame tails found none left. The remaining 'warrant', 'asserts' and 'binds' are other senses: a certificate warrants, warranted limits in D65, the core asserts nothing of an actual optimizer, a premise binds. valence 'none asserted' is atlas.py's validated constant and is kept.
